arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.rtype,
    COUNT(*) AS sat_rows,
    COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS matched_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_test_takers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(s.NumGE1500) NOT IN ('integer', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noninteger_score_counts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)") NOT IN ('real', 'integer', 'null')
              OR typeof(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") NOT IN ('real', 'integer', 'null')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonnumeric_meal_inputs,
    COUNT(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS stored_rate_rows
FROM main.satscores AS s
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY s.rtype

arguments.sql:
SELECT MAX(
    CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL)
    / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)
) AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM main.satscores AS s
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0.3
LIMIT 1
